title: Combined Credit Exposure Limit Across a Customer's Ridgeline Consumer Credit Accounts
content:
**Credit standard — combined exposure.** The combined credit extended to one customer across all Ridgeline Consumer Credit accounts — the total of the credit lines (or approved loan amounts) of every account in their name whose status is active or suspended — may not exceed 75000.00.

- **Reduction.** When an approval or a credit line increase would take the combined total above 75000.00, the new line is reduced to 75000.00 less the other open credit lines, rounded down to the tier's credit line rounding increment.
- **Other open credit lines** means the total of the credit lines of the customer's other Ridgeline Consumer Credit accounts — the account being decided excluded — whose status is active or suspended, as they stand at the moment of the decision. The room left under the limit (the headroom) is 75000.00 less that total.
- **Too small to grant.** If the reduced figure is below the tier's lowest credit line or loan amount, an application is declined and an increase is not granted.
- **What never counts.** Closed, declined and charged-off accounts never count toward the limit, and the account being decided is measured at its proposed new line.

## Worked figures (hypothetical accounts)

| Other open credit lines | Proposed new line | Combined total | New line |
|---|---|---|---|
| 50000.00 (a Project Loan 84, active) | 30000.00 on Card Premier | 80000.00, above the limit | 75000.00 less 50000.00 is 25000.00; rounded down to the 100.00 increment, 25000.00 |
| 54950.00 (a Project Loan 84, suspended) | 25000.00 on Card Premier | 79950.00, above the limit | 75000.00 less 54950.00 is 20050.00; rounded down, 20000.00 |
| 9900.00 (a Card Preferred, closed) | 30000.00 on Card Premier | 30000.00 (a closed account never counts) | 30000.00, unchanged |

In each reduced case the figure is then compared with the tier's lowest line: 20000.00 and 25000.00 are both at or above the Card Premier lowest line, so the line is granted at the reduced figure.
